name: Rimon Consulting & Management Services Ltd.
summary: Rimon Consulting & Management Services Ltd. provides end-to-end solutions for small to large scale projects for the public and private sectors in Israel. The company delivers infrastructure projects, such as water and natural gas networks, water reservoirs, pumping stations, water wells, marine works, construction waste recycling, and other civil infrastructure works. It is also involved in the provision of water and environmental solutions and services, including wastewater and effluent treatment and reuse for agriculture and drinking water; transmission and supply of water for agricultural, industrial, and municipal uses; water desalination and treatment systems; brine treatment and reuse;…
